data: Vsi proti vsem je politični triler, ki se dogaja v izmišljenem kraju Rovte pod idiličnimi Alpami in govori o demokraciji, volilnih prevarah in razkrajanju družbenih vrednot. (Elena is a student in Minsk, Belarus. She has a passionate but increasingly difficult relationship with her boyfriend Victor. When her father is arrested, she has to continue his illegal business. In order to make deals for him, she repeatedly has to drive into the 'forbidden zone' of Chernobyl. She finds herself attracted by the zone's deceptive beauty - but her life seems more and more contaminated by a destructive force.)
Vsi proti vsem je politični triler, ki se dogaja v izmišljenem kraju Rovte pod idiličnimi Alpami in govori o demokraciji, volilnih prevarah in razkrajanju družbenih vrednot.

Elena is a student in Minsk, Belarus. She has a passionate but increasingly difficult relationship with her boyfriend Victor. When her father is arrested, she has to continue his illegal business. In order to make deals for him, she repeatedly has to drive into the 'forbidden zone' of Chernobyl. She finds herself attracted by the zone's deceptive beauty - but her life seems more and more contaminated by a destructive force.
